items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Leslie, now the first big deal that I went on in New York... Leslie really (inaudible) me on my first trip to New York. ... Leslie was a pianist with the first band I went to New York with.

ctx.x: Trumpet and alto. He was younger than me, I think he was even in his teens then, and they had another youngster, Leslie Sheffield--
I worked with him. We went to Canada together in 1943. Leslie died recently in Oklahoma City.
